title: Candidate Engagement
summary: AI chatbot, automated follow-ups, WhatsApp integration and interview self-scheduling.
headline: Keep every candidate informed, *interested and moving forward*
lede: Great candidates drop out when they’re left waiting. TalentPool365 keeps them engaged from application to offer with instant answers, timely follow-ups and easy scheduling, without adding to your team’s workload.
sectionIntro: Great candidates drop out when they’re left waiting. TalentPool365 keeps them engaged from application to offer with instant answers, timely follow-ups and easy scheduling, without adding to your team’s workload.

capabilities.title: AI Chatbot
capabilities.tagline: Instant answers for candidates, any time of day.
capabilities.body: Candidates have questions about the role, the process and next steps. Our AI chatbot answers them right away on your career page, so no one is left guessing and your recruiters aren’t buried in repetitive messages.
points: Available 24/7 on your career page
Answers questions about roles, eligibility and the hiring process
Collects basic details and pre-screening answers
Hands over to a recruiter when a human is needed

capabilities.title: Automated Follow-Ups
capabilities.tagline: No candidate falls through the cracks.
capabilities.body: Set up follow-ups once and let TalentPool365 handle the rest. Candidates get reminders, status updates and nudges at the right moments, and your pipeline keeps moving.
points: Triggered by candidate stage or activity
Reminders to complete assessments or interviews
Status updates so candidates always know where they stand
Automatic nudges for candidates who haven’t responded

capabilities.title: WhatsApp Integration
capabilities.tagline: Reach candidates where they actually reply.
capabilities.body: Candidates respond faster on WhatsApp than on almost any other channel. Send updates, reminders and interview details directly to the app they already use every day.
points: Send job alerts, updates and reminders over WhatsApp
Two-way conversations managed from your workspace
Ready-to-use message templates
Candidate consent respected for every message

capabilities.title: Email Automation
capabilities.body: Create email sequences for outreach, acknowledgements, rejections and offers. Each message is personalized with the candidate’s details, so it feels written for them.
points: Customizable, reusable email templates
Personalization with candidate name, role and stage
Scheduled sequences and bulk sending
Open and reply tracking to see what’s working

capabilities.title: Interview Scheduling
capabilities.tagline: From “when are you free?” to booked in a click.
capabilities.body: Remove the back-and-forth. Candidates pick a time that suits them from your team’s available slots, and everyone gets the confirmation and reminders automatically.
points: Self-service slot booking for candidates
Calendar sync to avoid double bookings
Automatic confirmations, reminders and reschedule options
Supports both AI interviews and live interviews with your team

closingCta.headline: Make every candidate feel valued, from first message to final offer.
closingCta.body: See how TalentPool365 keeps candidates engaged automatically.
